findings: duplicate:true handling mismatch — History saves status=DUPLICATE and increments skippedCount, but spec says duplicate:true should be treated as success/skip (not a distinct status). Change to status=SUCCESS and add a flag or comment in history, or clarify in the spec what "success/skip" means.

Scheduler init with empty eligible roles — When no roles are configured, initPayrollScheduler proceeds and schedules a cron job that will wake every week and log "No eligible roles configured". This is harmless but wasteful. Consider logging a warning during init: "No eligible roles configured yet; payroll will run but skip processing until roles are added."
